segments.source: Wayengabafundiseli kwindlu yesikolo, kodwa phantsi komthi weselwa.
Ngokunye ukuhlwa, xa uGoso wayesahleli phantsi komthi, efunda nzulu ngezifundo zosuku olulandelayo, uPaa, ibhadi, wakhwela phezulu emthini ngokuthe cwaka ukuya kuba iziqhamo.
Ngokwenza loo nto, washukumisa, wawisa iselwa elithe ngokuwa labetha utitshala entloko lambulala.
Xa befika abantwana kusasa, bafumana utitshala wabo elele efile.
Ngoko ke, emva kokumnika umngcwabo ohloniphekileyo, bavumelana ukuba bafumane lo ubulele uGoso.
Emva kokuba bethethile ngalo mbandela, bafika kwisiqgibo sokuba umoya wasezantsi ngumoni.
Ngoko ke, bawubamba umoya wasezantsi bawubetha.
Baza bathi, "Ibinguwe ogibisele iselwa elibethe utitshala wethu uGoso.
"Umoya wasezantsi wathi, "Ukuba bendinamandla, ngendinganqandwa ludonga lodaka?"
Ngoko ke, baya kudonga lodaka balubetha.
Baza bathi, "Ibinguwe onqande umoya wasezantsi, lo owise iselwa elibethe utitshala wethu uGoso.
Udonga lodaka lwathi, "Ukuba bendinamandla ngendigqojozwe yimpuku?"
Ngoko ke, bahamba baya kubamba impuku bayibetha.
Baza bathi, "Ibinguwe ogqobhoze udonga lodaka, udonga olunqande umoya wasezantsi, lo owise iselwa elibethe utitshala wethu uGoso.
Ngoko ke, bazingela ikati, bayibamba, baza bayibetha.
Baphendula bathi, "Nguwe otye impuku, egqobhoze udonga lodaka; udonga olunqande umoya wasezantsi, lo owise iselwa elibethe utitshala wethu uGoso.
Baza bathi, "Nguwe obophelele ikati, etye impuku; egqobhoze udonga lodaka, olunqande umoya wasezantsi, lo owise iselwa elibethe utitshala wethu uGoso.
Baphendula bathi, "Usike intambo, ebophe ikati; etye impuku; egqobhoze udonga lodaka; olunqande umoya wasezantsi, lo owise iselwa elibethe utitshala wethu uGoso.
Bathi, "Utshise imesi, esike intambo; ebophelele ikati; etye impuku; egqobhoze udonga lodaka; olunqande umoya wasezantsi, lo owise iselwa elibethe utitshala wethu uGoso.
Umlilo wathi, "Ukuba bendinamandla, bendiza kucinywa ngamanzi?"
Bathi, "Ucime umlilo, otshise imesi; esike intambo; ebophelele ikati; etye impuku; egqobhoze udonga lodaka; olunqande umoya wasezantsi, lo owise iselwa elibethe utitshala wethu uGoso.

Baza bathi, "Usela amanzi, acime umlilo; otshise imesi; esike intambo; ebophelele ikati; etye impuku; egqobhoze udonga lodaka; olunqande umoya wasezantsi, lo owise iselwa elibethe utitshala wethu uGoso.

Bathi, "Utshutshisa inkomo, esele amanzi; acime umlilo; otshise imesi; esike intambo; ebophelele ikati; etye impuku; egqobhoze udonga lodaka; olunqande umoya wasezantsi, lo owise iselwa elibethe utitshala wethu uGoso.
Kodwa impukane yathi, "Ukuba bendinamandla, ngendityiwe libhadi?"

Bathi, "Utye impukane, etshutshise inkomo; esele amanzi; acime umlilo; otshise imesi; esike intambo, ebophelele ikati; etye impuku; egqobhoze udonga lodaka; olunqande umoya wasezantsi, lo owise iselwa elibethe utitshala wethu uGoso.
UPaa, ngokumangaliseka ekubeni efumanekile, nangokoyika iziphumo zokubulala utitshala ngengozi, wathi cwaka.
Ngulo mfo ojule iselwa ezantsi elibethe utitshala wethu uGoso.
